row.notes: Whole body read. Runs only when vis+0x1ad4 == id and part +0x5e0[part*0x50] and slot +0x137c[slot*0x48] are valid. Advances timer +0x5d4[part*0x50] by dt; when it passes the max duration reported by the part's tracks (vcall +0x20) resets it and sets +0x1adc = 0x1e, +0x1ad0 = 0, +0x1ae8 = 0. Otherwise writes sine-shaped fade weights (1 - pow(1 - sin, n)) to +0x600[part] and +0x1380[slot], scaled by a factor from abs(+0xff4) and side +0xec8[part]; stores out ptr at +0x1ae0, offsets amp*weight to +0x1b60..+0x1b68 or +0x1b70..+0x1b78 by side and a 0..1 weight to +0x1ac8 or +0x1ac4; skips offsets when two bone positions (bone_idx vs +0x10b0/+0x10b4) are within 0.01. Context from caller: Car_Visual_UpdatePartVibration (itself L1) calls it 10 times with fixed ids 1..9 and constants. The timer/duration/side logic looks like a one-shot timed animation blend rather than vibration. Better context needed: what sets +0x1ad4 and what +0xff4 is; name kept, stays L1.
